name: ghost-fibers
title: Ghost Fibers
description: Layered ribbons of fine glowing fibers that twist, fold and drift through soft depth of field.

files.content:
import type { GhostFibersLook, GhostFibersPresetName } from './types';

const GHOST_FIBERS_LOOK: GhostFibersLook = {
  glowColor: '#8b5cf6',
  lineColor: '#dfd1fc',
  secondaryColor: '#6f4ac5',
  gradient: 'depth',
  layers: 3,
  waves: 1,
  twist: 1.2,
  volume: 0.7,
  spread: 1,
  scale: 1,
  rotation: 18,
  perspective: 0.65,
  threads: 72,
  density: 1,
  thickness: 1,
  fiberStyle: 'dots',
  tips: 0,
  foldGlow: 1,
  speed: 0.5,
  flow: 0.4,
  rollSpeed: 0.15,
  depthOfField: 0.85,
  focusDepth: 0,
  particles: 0.5,
  sparkle: 0.5,
  glow: 0.8,
  brightness: 1,
  vignette: 0.3,
  grain: 0.06,
};

const PRESETS: Record<GhostFibersPresetName, Partial<GhostFibersLook>> = {
  violet: {},
  fiber: {
    glowColor: '#3b6bff',
    lineColor: '#dff4ff',
    secondaryColor: '#22d3ee',
    gradient: 'along',
    fiberStyle: 'lines',
    tips: 1,
    layers: 2,
    twist: 0.5,
    waves: 0.8,
    volume: 0.5,
    threads: 96,
    flow: 0.25,
    foldGlow: 0.3,
    sparkle: 0.3,
    depthOfField: 1.1,
  },
  minimal: {
    glowColor: '#d4d4d8',
    lineColor: '#ffffff',
    secondaryColor: '#a1a1aa',
    layers: 1,
    twist: 1.5,
    volume: 0.4,
    threads: 54,
    particles: 0.15,
    sparkle: 0.35,
    foldGlow: 1.5,
    glow: 0.6,
    depthOfField: 0.6,
  },
  prism: {
    glowColor: '#8b5cf6',
    lineColor: '#ffffff',
    secondaryColor: '#2dd4bf',
    gradient: 'across',
    twist: 1.6,
    waves: 1.2,
    spread: 1.25,
    foldGlow: 1.3,
  },
  ember: {
    glowColor: '#ff6a1a',
    lineColor: '#ffd9a8',
    secondaryColor: '#e11d48',
    fiberStyle: 'dashes',
    flow: 0.9,
    speed: 0.7,
    sparkle: 1,
    particles: 0.9,
    twist: 0.9,
    rotation: 8,
  },
  silk: {
    glowColor: '#34d399',
    lineColor: '#ecfdf5',
    secondaryColor: '#0ea5e9',
    fiberStyle: 'lines',
    layers: 2,
    twist: 0.7,
    waves: 1.5,
    volume: 1.1,
    threads: 120,
    foldGlow: 2,
    sparkle: 0.2,
    particles: 0.25,
    depthOfField: 0.45,
  },
  bokeh: {
    glowColor: '#e879f9',
    lineColor: '#ffffff',
    secondaryColor: '#818cf8',
    depthOfField: 1.7,
    focusDepth: -0.45,
    particles: 1.6,
    thickness: 1.3,
    density: 0.7,
    sparkle: 1.2,
    brightness: 0.75,
  },
};

/** Darker ink colors used when the effect is drawn on a light background. */
const LIGHT_SWAP: Record<GhostFibersPresetName, Partial<GhostFibersLook>> = {
  violet: {
    glowColor: '#7c3aed',
    lineColor: '#4c1d95',
    secondaryColor: '#a78bfa',
  },
  fiber: {
    glowColor: '#2563eb',
    lineColor: '#1e3a8a',
    secondaryColor: '#0891b2',
  },
  minimal: {
    glowColor: '#3f3f46',
    lineColor: '#09090b',
    secondaryColor: '#a1a1aa',
  },
  prism: {
    glowColor: '#7c3aed',
    lineColor: '#4c1d95',
    secondaryColor: '#0d9488',
  },
  ember: {
    glowColor: '#ea580c',
    lineColor: '#9a3412',
    secondaryColor: '#be123c',
  },
  silk: {
    glowColor: '#059669',
    lineColor: '#065f46',
    secondaryColor: '#0284c7',
  },
  bokeh: {
    glowColor: '#c026d3',
    lineColor: '#86198f',
    secondaryColor: '#4f46e5',
  },
};

export const GHOST_FIBERS_PRESET_OPTIONS: Record<
  string,
  GhostFibersPresetName
> = {
  Violet: 'violet',
  'Fiber Optic': 'fiber',
  Minimal: 'minimal',
  Prism: 'prism',
  Ember: 'ember',
  Silk: 'silk',
  Bokeh: 'bokeh',
};

export function isGhostFibersPreset(
  value: unknown,
): value is GhostFibersPresetName {
  return typeof value === 'string' && value in PRESETS;
}

/** Full look for a preset: the defaults, the preset overrides, then the light-mode ink colors. */
export function ghostFibersPreset(
  name: GhostFibersPresetName,
  light = false,
): GhostFibersLook {
  return {
    ...GHOST_FIBERS_LOOK,
    ...PRESETS[name],
    ...(light ? LIGHT_SWAP[name] : {}),
  };
}
